tasbih-dhikr-counter.formula:
Rounds completed = floor(count / target)
Progress in round (%) = ((count mod target) / target) x 100
Ring offset = circumference x (1 - progress / 100), circumference = 2 x pi x 54
Vibration: 25 ms per tap; [120, 60, 120] ms on round completion

tasbih-dhikr-counter.quickAnswer: Tasbih / Dhikr Counter is a focused digital counter for remembrance. Pick from five common dhikr phrases, set a target of 33, 100, 500, 1000, or any custom number, and tap the big circle once per recitation. A progress ring fills through each round, vibration marks taps and completed rounds, the rounds counter tracks your sets, and your count auto-saves on your device so you can continue later — all privately in your browser with no signup.
tasbih-dhikr-counter.tagline: Count your dhikr with a tap — targets, progress ring, and round vibration.
tasbih-dhikr-counter.workedExample: You choose 'SubhanAllah' with a target of 100 and tap 250 times. Rounds = floor(250 / 100) = 2 complete rounds. Progress in the current round = ((250 mod 100) / 100) x 100 = 50%, so the ring is half full and the counter shows 50 / 100. At tap 100 and tap 200 the phone gave the longer double-buzz marking each completed round. Close the page at 250 — reopening restores count 250, target 100, and 'SubhanAllah' from local storage.
